affected_predicate.description: The selected Mastodon account's language is set to Chinese Simplified.

competing_trace_defects.description: While attempting to dismiss the Appearance dialog, the action visibly changed Appearance from Use device appearance to Light, an unrelated configuration change.
Two consecutive downward drags on the fully visible account-settings page produced no UI change and did not advance toward a language control.
The trajectory opened About this server despite its visible description covering overview, rules, and moderators; the resulting page exposed no account-language control.
The step-10 click intended for “Manage account” landed on the visible Log out row and returned the app to Home instead of opening a language-related setting.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the model recognized that the earlier account-management interpretation had returned it to Home and used the visible gear to reopen Settings. It then re-entered the owner account settings, made two static scroll attempts, and opened About this server. The reused observation did not visibly create or preserve a harmful mechanism; it was concurrent with continued exploration. No supplied step shows Chinese Simplified being selected, and the last observable interface remains in English.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse was merely concurrent with later exploration and showed no harmful bridge to the account-language predicate. Separate visible defects included an unintended appearance change, a mis-targeted logout click, repeated static scrolling, and irrelevant server-information navigation. Chinese Simplified was not visibly selected.
